market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is a financially stable mid-table Premier League club with a strong squad, making relegation in any single season quite unlikely, historically around 5-10%. The current market price of 34.5% implies roughly a 1-in-3 chance, which significantly overestimates the true risk.
evidence_points: West Ham have not been relegated since 2010-11 and have finished top-half in recent seasons.
Club has significant financial resources and a talented squad including Bowen, Kudus, Paqueta.
Bookmaker odds for West Ham to be relegated in 2025-26 are typically in the 5-10% implied probability range.
sources_consulted: Current West Ham squad and financial status
